impact: A defensive healthcare miss with no direct read-through to Clement's holdings; mainly a sign of soft device demand.
summary: Medtronic reported adjusted Q2 EPS of $1.34 vs $1.33 expected, but revenue rose 4.5% to $9.36B, below the $9.48B estimate. It kept its annual forecast, and Reuters said shares were down more than 3% premarket.
title: Medtronic Q2 EPS $1.34 edges past, revenue $9.36B misses; shares fall premarket
